basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Registers immutable model releases and decides, per context, whether one is installable and canonical.
Withdraws a release from new use without deleting it, so past results stay reproducible.
Ties canonical status to evidence and open holds rather than to a version number.

may: Validate a release record and retain its evidence.
Report installability for a stated context.
mustNot: Grant operational permission because a release is accepted.
Mark a release canonical while a hold is open.
requiresHuman: Withdrawing a release that installations depend on.

considerations: Models shape how organizations see people and work; accepting a release is a decision someone must own.
Reproducibility of past decisions depends on keeping withdrawn releases available.
affectedParties: People described by data structured with the model

owners.steward: The model publisher owns releases; the installing organization owns its acceptance decision.

items: Release ID with version and specification digest, immutable.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A release record pins one model version by digest and lists assessments, holds and status.
Losing the ability to reproduce results after a withdrawal.
Software supply-chain attestations such as SLSA provenance.
Adoption of Vercy model releases inside a Company Dimension.

sections.whatItIs: A companion contract for a Company Dimension that registers immutable model releases, derives whether each is installable and canonical in a given context from evidence and holds, and withdraws releases from new use without deleting them.

sources.title: Research record EM-XCT-10: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
